variables.meter_vals: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r, m in rooms_heat.items() %}{% for e in m['add'] + m['sub'] + ([m['ac']] if m['ac'] else []) %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{e: states(e)}) %}{% endfor %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}

variables.heat_now: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r, m in rooms_heat.items() %}{% set ok = namespace(v=true, a=0) %}{% for e in m['add'] + m['sub'] + ([m['ac']] if m['ac'] else []) %}{% if not is_number(meter_vals.get(e)) %}{% set ok.v = false %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% if ok.v %}{% for e in m['add'] %}{% set ok.a = ok.a + meter_vals[e] | float %}{% endfor %}{% for e in m['sub'] %}{% set ok.a = ok.a - meter_vals[e] | float %}{% endfor %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: [ok.a | round(2), (meter_vals[m['ac']] | float | round(2)) if m['ac'] else 0]}) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}

variables.snap_json: {% set ns = namespace(T={}, C={}) %}{% for s in states.sensor | selectattr('entity_id', 'match', 'sensor\.climate_temp_') %}{% set r = s.entity_id[20:] %}{% if r != 'outdoor' and is_number(s.state) %}{% set ns.T = dict(ns.T, **{r: s.state | float | round(1)}) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for s in states.sensor | selectattr('entity_id', 'match', 'sensor\.climate_co2_') %}{% set r = s.entity_id[19:] %}{% if is_number(s.state) %}{% set ns.C = dict(ns.C, **{r: s.state | float | round(0) | int}) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ {'t': as_timestamp(now()) | int, 'o': states('sensor.climate_temp_outdoor') | float | round(1), 'T': ns.T, 'C': ns.C} | to_json }}

data.value: {{ now().strftime('%d.%m') }} skipped: snapshot too large ({{ snap_json | length }} chars)

variables.hours: {{ ((as_timestamp(now()) - snap.t) / 3600) | round(2) if snap is mapping and snap.t is defined else 0 }}

variables.skip: {% if snap.t is not defined %}unreadable snapshot{% elif not is_number(states('sensor.climate_temp_outdoor')) %}no outdoor temperature{% elif hours < 1.5 %}too short{% endif %}

variables.now_C: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r in snap.C %}{% set v = states('sensor.climate_co2_' ~ r) %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: v | float if is_number(v) else none}) %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}
variables.now_T: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r in snap.T %}{% set v = states('sensor.climate_temp_' ~ r) %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: v | float if is_number(v) else none}) %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}
variables.prev_ach: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r in snap.C %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: states('input_number.leak_ach_' ~ r) | float(0)}) %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}
variables.prev_k: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r in snap.T %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: states('input_number.leak_k_' ~ r) | float(0)}) %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}

variables.heat_w: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% if heat_snap is mapping and hours > 0 %}{% for r in heat_now %}{% set s = heat_snap.get(r) %}{% set e = heat_now[r] %}{% if s is not none and e[0] >= s[0] and e[1] >= s[1] %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: {'w': ((e[0] - s[0]) * 1000 / hours) | round(0) | int, 'ac': ((e[1] - s[1]) * 1000 / hours) | round(0) | int}}) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% endif %}{{ ns.d }}

variables.ach: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% for r in snap.C %}{% set c1 = snap.C[r] %}{% set c2 = now_C.get(r) %}{% if c2 is number and (c1 - 400) >= 100 and c2 < c1 %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: (log((c1 - 400) / ([c2 - 400, 30] | max)) / hours) | round(2)}) %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}
variables.k: {% set ns = namespace(d={}) %}{% set hold = (states('input_number.climate_away_min') | float(0)) + 0.5 %}{% set o = (snap.o + now_o) / 2 %}{% for r in snap.T %}{% set t1 = snap.T[r] %}{% set t2 = now_T.get(r) %}{% set h = heat_w.get(r) %}{% set g = o + ((h['w'] / ua[r]) if h is mapping and r in ua else 0) %}{% if t2 is number and (t1 - o) >= 3 %}{% if r in rooms_heat and h is not mapping %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: -3}) %}{% elif h is mapping and h['ac'] > 50 %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: -2}) %}{% elif (t1 - g) < 3 or t2 >= t1 or t2 <= hold %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: -1}) %}{% elif (t2 - g) > 0.5 %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{r: (100 * log((t1 - g) / (t2 - g)) / hours) | round(1)}) %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d }}

variables.signals: {% set ns = namespace(v=[], out=[]) %}{% for r in k %}{% if k[r] > 0 %}{% set ns.v = ns.v + [k[r]] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% set s = ns.v | sort %}{% set n = s | count %}{% set med = ((s[(n - 1) // 2] + s[n // 2]) / 2) if n else 0 %}{% for r, v in k | dictsort(by='value', reverse=true) %}{% if v > 0 %}{% set p = prev_k.get(r, 0) | float(0) %}{% set hs = v >= 2 * med %}{% set me = p > 0 and v >= 1.8 * p %}{% if hs and me %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [r ~ ':window'] %}{% elif hs %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [r ~ ':leakiest'] %}{% elif me %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [r ~ ':changed'] %}{% endif %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for r, a in ach | dictsort %}{% set p = prev_ach.get(r, 0) | float(0) %}{% if p > 0 and a >= 1.8 * p %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + ['air:' ~ r] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.out }}

variables.verdict: {% set kk = k | dictsort(by='value', reverse=true) %}{{ now().strftime('%d.%m') }} {{ hours }} h at {{ ((snap.o + now_o) / 2) | round(1) }} C. Air/h: {% for r, a in ach | dictsort %}{{ r }} {{ a }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% else %}-{% endfor %}. Heat loss %/h: {% for r, v in kk %}{{ r }} {{ {-1: 'warm', -2: 'AC on', -3: 'no meter'}[v] if v < 0 else v }}{{ ', ' if not loop.last }}{% endfor %}. {{ signals | join(' ') if signals else 'nothing odd' }}
variables.writes: {% set ns = namespace(l=[]) %}{% for r in k %}{% if k[r] > 0 and (r ~ ':window') not in signals and has_value('input_number.leak_k_' ~ r) %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [{'e': 'input_number.leak_k_' ~ r, 'v': [k[r], 50] | min}] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{% for r in ach %}{% if has_value('input_number.leak_ach_' ~ r) %}{% set ns.l = ns.l + [{'e': 'input_number.leak_ach_' ~ r, 'v': [ach[r], 5] | min}] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.l }}

data.message: {% set w = signals | select('search', ':window$') | map('replace', ':window', '') | list %}While you were out, {{ w | join(' and ') }} lost heat at least twice as fast as the rest of the flat and much faster than last time. Check {{ 'its window' if w | count == 1 else 'their windows' }}.
data.title: A window may be open

description: The radiators drop to the Away floor 30 min into Away (Climate - radiators), so the snapshot (input_text.leak_meter_snapshot, survives a restart) is taken an hour after that, at 1 h 30 min; the run ends when Away ends or when arrival pre-heat turns the heating back on, whichever is first (2026-11-25: the first live run started on warm radiators and ended 37 min into pre-heat, and stored three rooms 3-10x too airtight; tests/climate/wiring.py checks both timings against the radiators). At the end: per room the % of its indoor-outdoor gap lost per hour, per CO2 room the air changes per hour. Socket heat (2026-11-27, operator: the office rack, the living-room PoE): each room's metered sockets (rooms_heat; a battery's net charge is not heat) are read at both ends (input_text.leak_meter_heat) and their mean watts move the point the room cools toward from outdoors to outdoors + W / H, H = the room's heat loss in W/K from the 1997 radiator sizing (ua; docs/heating-energy-rating.md). A room whose own sockets hold it within 3 C of its temperature is kept warm, not measured. A metered room whose meters could not be read is not measured (no meter), nor is one whose air conditioner drew over 50 W (AC on). wiring.py checks every metered socket in a measured room is listed. Stored in input_number.leak_k_* / leak_ach_*; summary in input_text.leak_meter_verdict. A room >= 2x the flat's median and >= 1.8x its own last run = probably a window open: push to Vadim, and that run is not stored as its baseline. Templates because the decay maths has no native helper. A room that cooled to climate_away_min + 0.5 C was heated from then on and is reported kept warm, not measured (review #49 F5). Both floors share air over the open stairs, so a window anywhere also raises its neighbours' loss; the median absorbs some of it (F6). A skipped run writes its reason to the verdict (F4). Accepted: a restart in the first hour of Away loses that run's snapshot (F3), baselines do not age (F7), unmetered heat (the fridge in the living room) is not counted.
